question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure FCoE on a Cisco Nexus switch. Which two command sets complete this configuration? (Choose two.)
context:
vlan 10
 fcoe vsan 10

interface ethernet 1/3
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
options:
interface vfc 10
 bind interface ethernet 1/3
 no shut

interface vfc 10
 bind interface fcoe-vfc 1/3
 no shut

interface fcoe 10
 bind interface ethernet 1/3
 no shut
theory: Bringing up FCoE on a Cisco Nexus switch requires two coordinated pieces: mapping the FCoE VLAN to a VSAN (already done here with 'vlan 10 / fcoe vsan 10'), and then creating a virtual Fibre Channel interface bound to the Ethernet port carrying that VLAN. Adding the vfc to VSAN membership is done in the VSAN database ('vsan 10 interface vfc 10'), while the vfc's link to the physical Ethernet interface is created under the vfc interface itself with 'bind interface ethernet 1/3' followed by 'no shut' to bring it up - both steps are required and neither can substitute for the other. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE Implementation)
